resolutions: The facade stays same-origin and session-authenticated; existing Bearer routes remain untouched.
Directory pagination and filtering are server-owned and app-scoped, not browser-side fixture filtering.
The facade projects existing source and authority facts without creating a second lifecycle or mutation owner.
current_flow: The completed browser facade now provides session-bound app-scoped agent and role projections; its direct dependencies remain the existing Agent and CustomRole persistence/services.

criteria_map.Agent and custom-role lists support serv: The facade adds explicit query DTOs and repository-backed app-scoped projections.
criteria_map.Browser routes enforce session, Administ: The route follows the browser-auth helpers and dedicated browser scope policy.
criteria_map.Source attachment, capability authority,: The facade calls existing services and emits sanitized representations rather than persisting alternate state.

new_abstractions: A narrow browser-only DTO projection is required to keep raw persistence and credentials out of the web client.

citations.finding: Existing browser routes separate session reads from admin mutations.
Sources and capabilities have deliberately different durable meanings.
